visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of six adult males stands on a sunlit urban sidewalk under a dark overhang. The man closest to the camera, wearing a black t-shirt and blue animal-ear headband, holds a smartphone up to capture a group selfie. The others behind him strike varied poses, some with hands on their faces or pointing at the camera. The background features a closed shop with green metal shutters and a white paper lantern hanging from foliage. (2) The group transitions into more coordinated, though humorous, poses. They are all wearing colorful animal-ear headbands in pink, blue, and green. One man in a yellow shirt with a Mickey Mouse graphic squats in the center. Others stand with arms crossed in a stylized fashion or make hand gestures towards their cheeks. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting their varied casual outfits like white t-shirts and khaki pants. (3) The group breaks their pose and begins walking away down the sidewalk. A man in a light-colored shirt and pink headbands holds a drink in a clear plastic cup. Another in a white shirt walks alongside him. The camera follows them from behind as they move past other closed storefronts. The scene feels candid and unscripted as they interact and laugh with each other. (4) The camera maintains a handheld follow shot as the group moves further away into the distance. One individual stops briefly and turns his head back towards the camera while the others continue walking. The sidewalk is bordered by a metal railing on the right, beyond which more city street elements are visible. The overall mood remains lighthearted and chaotic as the take ends.
